description: This file defines the class Image_Graph_Plot_Dot, which is a plot type for rendering scatter/dot charts using the PEAR Image_Graph library. It includes methods for drawing legend samples and rendering the plot.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_Dot
classes.description: A class for rendering dot/scatter plots that display markers for data points.

methods.name: _drawLegendSample
methods.description: Draws a sample marker in the legend area for the plot.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Renders the plot on the canvas, handling grouping and marker drawing.
